queries: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_price_per_day, avg_price_per_day / AVG(avg_price_per_day) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_of_ratings FROM r ORDER BY rating

assumptions.assumption: Rental price per day is each film's rental_rate divided by its rental_duration. This is averaged over the films in each rating.
The comparison base is the unweighted mean of the five rating-level per-day averages, so each rating counts once. It is not weighted by film count.
Films with a NULL rating are not expected. If any exist, they would form their own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Per-day price taken at rating level as the average rental_rate divided by the average rental_duration, instead of averaging per-film ratios.

assumptions.assumption: Price per day of rental is computed per film as rental_rate / rental_duration, then averaged over the films in each rating.
The 'plain average across the ratings (each rating counted once)' is the unweighted mean of the five per-rating average per-day prices, not weighted by film count.
Averages are over all films in the film table, with no inventory weighting, and values are left unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Per-day price per rating is the ratio of averages (average rental_rate divided by average rental_duration) rather than the average of per-film ratios.
